serf.definition: n. (Middle Ages) a person who is bound to the land and owned by the feudal lord
serf.translation: n. 农奴, 奴隶, 服苦役的人

serfage.translation: n. 农奴地位, 农奴境遇

serfdom.definition: n. the state of a serf
serfdom.translation: n. 农权制, 农奴地位, 农奴境遇, 奴役

serfhood.definition: n the state of a serf

serfs.definition: n. (Middle Ages) a person who is bound to the land and owned by the feudal lord
serfs.translation: n. 农奴, 奴隶( serf的复数形式 ); 像农奴般遭受奴役的人
